title: Restaurant serving beer and wine in Plano

input.what: Sichuan restaurant serving beer and wine

assumptions: An existing Texas LLC. Hires staff. Builds out. No new sign. Serves beer and wine, no spirits.

items.name: Employer Identification Number (EIN)
items.note: IRS: "You never have to pay a fee for an EIN."

items.name: Sales and Use Tax Permit
items.feeNote: No fee; a security may be required.
items.note: One permit for each active place of business.

items.name: Unemployment tax account
items.note: Register within 10 days of becoming liable.

items.name: Food handler training for food employees
items.agency: Texas Department of State Health Services
items.note: Within 30 days of employment (§228.31); certified food managers exempt.

items.name: Assumed Name Certificate
items.condition: Only when trading under a name other than the legal name.

items.name: Certified food manager
items.agency: Texas Department of State Health Services (licensed programs); required on site by Houston Health

items.name: Certificate of Occupancy
items.quote: A Certificate of Occupancy is required to occupy any building or property with nonresidential or multifamily uses.

items.name: Food establishment plan review
items.quote: The City of Plano Food Code requires that complete plans be submitted, reviewed and approved before any construction and/ or remodeling can begin.

items.name: Food establishment permit
items.match: (food establishment permit|food permit).*(plano)|(plano).*(food establishment permit|food permit)

items.name: Wine and Malt Beverage Retailer's Permit (BG)
items.quote: You are authorized to sell wine and malt beverages at your bar or restaurant.

items.name: Alcohol dealer registration (TTB F 5630.5d)
items.agency: Alcohol and Tobacco Tax and Trade Bureau
items.note: "No person may engage in the business of selling or offering to sell distilled spirits, wine, or beer without first registering." Before engaging in business; no fee stated.

order.why: Plans approved before construction; the permit after.

mustNotInclude.name: Any California, New York or Los Angeles alcohol step
mustNotInclude.match: state liquor authority|alcoholic beverage control|conditional use permit to sell alcohol|community board
